blocks.text: Another physical benefit takes longer to achieve, but it is well worth the effort, particularly for women. If done regularly and over a long period of time, exercise can help prevent osteoporosis, a disease of gradual bone loss that becomes more common as people age. Bone loss can be slowed by regular exercise. It actually helps increase bone mass, and is said to be the best preventive measure to avoid osteoporosis.
